method: Manual 2-D landmark estimates on exact decoded source frames across the full clip; no interpolated or generated body poses in this file. Stationary bag measurements after settling are repeated across samples.

coordinate_system.precision_note: Integer coordinates are manual estimates, typically about 3–7 pixels for visible joints. Concealed floor-work joints and anatomical side assignments can be substantially less precise. This is a 2-D visual trace, not calibrated motion capture.

visibility.2: located from a visible feature or limb/shoe contour
visibility.1: inferred under costume, sign, or overlapping body part; not directly observed
visibility.0: not locatable in this frame; no coordinate supplied

contact_format: contacts.left/right are foot sole/pavement anchors; contacts.left_hand/right_hand are palm or visible hand/pavement anchors. Null means no observed/assigned contact, including when support is outside the source crop; it does not by itself mean airborne. Visibility 1 flags an inferred concealed contact. Toes and wrists remain anatomical landmarks distinct from contacts.
sign_geometry: quad is a four-point approximation of the visible bent-arrow envelope, clockwise in image space; it is not a calibrated rigid rectangle. Frame-edge intersections are marked by clipped_edges. arrow_tip is separately measured only when visible. Do not infer an off-screen full sign from a clipped quad.
anatomical_tracking_note: Left/right follow the performer across pivots, inversions, and floor sweeps. Covered joint positions and ambiguous side placements are flagged inferred. Facing is coarse and facing_inferred marks samples with occluded heads. Far arm and hip locations under loose cloth are less certain than visible hands, knees, and shoes.

coverage.sampling_note: Opening samples retained. Later motion is sampled every five source frames with nine additional samples at hand plants, lift-off, inversion hand changes, support transfers, and fast leg/edge turns. Only selected source poses are measured; interpolation is a renderer concern.

events.name: sign_release_bracket
events.certainty: release is bracketed between these measured frames, not asserted at an unseen exact instant

events.name: first_palm_contact_bracket
events.certainty: Selected-frame bracket; no exact unseen first-contact instant asserted.

events.name: bag_grounding_and_settle
events.certainty: Bag fall and settling are distinguished; exact strap detachment time is not asserted.

editorial_recommendation.scope: Use the full source motion through frame 547, including inversion, sustained bridge arm sweeps, alternating-palm leg turns, and partial camera-right exit.
editorial_recommendation.framing: Preserve source translation and crop. Do not recenter the performer or invent unseen limbs, a completed exit, a standing recovery, or a return to the opening stance.
editorial_recommendation.props: Released sign remains hidden after its visible exit. Bag follows the measured swing/fall and remains at its ground position after settling.

clipped_boundary_format: Optional {landmark_name:[x,y,visibility]} supplies a measured limb/torso contour intersection at x=0/640 or y=0/360 solely to render clipping. It is not the off-screen joint position. Such actual joint points remain [null,null,0]. Visibility 1 reflects the estimated center of the observed contour at the edge. Do not draw an endpoint joint cap or shoe at a boundary substitute.
bag_format: Optional bag object: state attached/falling/resting; centre [x,y,visibility]; quad is a visible body envelope, not the strap and not calibrated geometry. Null centre means the bag is concealed. Resting measurements are stationary at the source-ground position after frame 385.
head_size_format: Optional head_size [radius_x,radius_y] is an approximate visible head/hair envelope radius in 640x360 source coordinates; no camera-distance scale is inferred from unavailable heads.
near_leg_format: near_leg left/right/none is a coarse anatomical overlap/layer cue assessed from the visible crossing legs; it is not a 3-D depth measurement.
